title: Site architecture
purpose: Plan clear page hierarchy, navigation, URL structure, and internal-link relationships for discovery and user comprehension.
whenToUse: Restructuring information architecture, navigation, URLs, or internal linking.
requiredInputs: Current page inventory or representative structure
steps: Group pages by intent and topic.
Define hierarchy and canonical destination pages.
Map navigation and contextual internal links.
Identify orphan, duplicate, or excessively deep paths.
checks: Do not assume crawl depth or orphan status without a page/link inventory.
Preserve migration and redirect requirements as explicit implementation work.
outputs: Advisory hierarchy, navigation, URL, and internal-link plan.
evidenceRules: Observed evidence must stay distinct from recommendations and third-party method guidance.
Missing observed data remains unknown and must never be converted to zero, failure, or success.
Any externally sourced benchmark or claim must retain provenance and applicability limits.
forbiddenInferences: Do not fabricate rankings, citations, traffic, conversions, backlinks, performance, or verification state.
Do not elevate advisory output into P7 authoritative facts, deterministic scores, P8 risk, approvals, mutation authority, or VERIFIED status.
Do not request or use credentials, execute commands, call networks, mutate databases, publish, deploy, merge, or perform runtime actions.
